title: Real sensor and environmental anchors for VEX-47 across Mars, Titan and vacuum environments
question: Source-grounded audit of the exact OTA-TEC-0037 document, restricted to its real-world anchors. Assess only: (1) the real sensor principles named for the VEX-47 baseline — optical imaging, infrared sensing, atmospheric/compositional analysis and particle detection — and their known operating constraints in Mars-like dust, Titan-like cold/dense atmosphere and vacuum/asteroid environments; (2) the effect of dust/haze on optical and infrared sensing and what mitigation is realistically required; (3) thermal-management and electronics/sensor packaging constraints across vacuum, Mars and Titan conditions; and (4) the audio-system caveat that microphones/loudspeakers require a material medium and therefore cannot operate as ordinary airborne audio devices in vacuum, while Titan/Mars acoustic behavior differs from Earth. Report real-world constraints that should be reflected in wording, but do not attempt to validate fictional propulsion or energy systems. Explicitly exclude Casimir-Drift, vacuum-energy thrust, Thorium-Mikrozelle, Mantrika-Kristall-Verstärkung, Post-PROMETHEUS law/canon, resonance sensors, Blackpearl technology, AVI-derived life-sign sensing, Kha-Null, the 174–963/233/528 Hz settings, Vex's emergent personality, fictional performance numbers, or any NOXIA balancing value. The individual instance `vex-lain-einheit-01` is out of scope except to verify that its fictional modifications are not generalized into real sensor claims or the VEX-47 type.
why_now: OTA-TEC-0037 is deliberately fiction-heavy but embeds a small set of real sensor/environment assertions. This is a useful test that the OTA technical-object contract can research real anchors without trying to scientifically validate fictional machinery or instance-specific canon.
real_world_anchor: Planetary exploration sensor systems, Mars dust and atmosphere, Titan atmospheric/thermal environment, vacuum-compatible sensing and acoustics.
novelty_reason: First source-pinned real-anchor audit of a predominantly fictional OTA→NOXIA technical object with an embedded individual instance.
